Meet Peter

I'm a creative designer passionate about crafting experiences that connect brands with their audiences through thoughtful design and strategic thinking.

For the past 8 years, I've been helping startups and established companies solve complex challenges through design. I believe great design isn't just about making things look beautiful—it's about understanding people, solving problems, and creating meaningful connections between brands and their customers.

Experience

Leading design for high-growth startups and established brands across web, mobile, and product design.

Designed and optimized user experiences for B2B software products serving enterprise clients.

Developed comprehensive brand identities and responsive websites for clients ranging from local startups to national retailers.

Supported senior designers on various projects including print materials, digital assets, and brand campaigns.

Education

Concentrated in visual communication and digital design with coursework in typography, color theory, user experience, and brand strategy.

Intensive 12-week program covering user research methodologies, information architecture, prototyping, and usability testing.
